./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:const BULLET_SCENE = preload("res://scenes/weapons/Bullet.tscn")
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:var fire_timer := 0.0
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:func _process(delta: float) -> void:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	# Kein Feuern, wenn der Spieler tot ist
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var owner: Node2D = get_parent()
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	if owner == null or not owner.is_inside_tree():
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		return
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	# 1. Schuss-Timer herunterzählen
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	fire_timer -= delta
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	if fire_timer <= 0.0:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		_shoot()
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		fire_timer = 1.0 / float(GameState.stats.fire_rate)
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	# 2. Nur noch zum nächsten Gegner drehen (keine Position-Verschiebung mehr)
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var target := _nearest_enemy()
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	if target:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		var dir_to_enemy = (target.global_position - global_position).normalized()
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		rotation = dir_to_enemy.angle()
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	else:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		rotation = 0.0
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:func _shoot() -> void:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var target := _nearest_enemy()
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	if target == null:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		return
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var bullet := BULLET_SCENE.instantiate()
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	get_tree().current_scene.add_child(bullet)
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	# Exakter Spawnpunkt vom Marker2D ("Muzzle"). 
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	# Da der Marker mitrotiert, stimmt die Position für rechts UND links automatisch!
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var muzzle := get_node_or_null("Sprite2D/SpawnPoint") as Marker2D
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var spawn_pos = muzzle.global_position if muzzle else global_position
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	bullet.global_position = spawn_pos
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	# Schussrichtung exakt von der Mündung zum Gegner
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var shoot_dir = (target.global_position - spawn_pos).normalized()
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	bullet.setup(
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		shoot_dir,
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		float(GameState.stats.bullet_speed),
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		int(GameState.stats.damage)
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	)
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:func _nearest_enemy() -> Node2D:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var enemies := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies")
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var nearest: Node2D = null
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	var nearest_dist := INF
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	for e in enemies:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		var d := global_position.distance_squared_to(e.global_position)
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:		if d < nearest_dist:
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:			nearest_dist = d
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:			nearest = e
./scenes/weapons/Weapon.gd:	return nearest

./scenes/weapons/Bullet.gd:			hide() # Kugel unsichtbar machen

./scenes/game/Game.gd:		player.health = min(player.health + upgrade.value, GameState.stats.max_health)
./scenes/game/Game.gd:		GameState.health_changed.emit(player.health, GameState.stats.max_health)
./scenes/game/Game.gd:

./scenes/game/Game.gd:# ── Hintergrund: Wüstenlandschaft mit Sanddünen und Hitzeflimmern ──────────────
./scenes/game/Game.gd:
./scenes/game/Game.gd:func _setup_background() -> void:
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	var shader_code := "shader_type canvas_item;\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "uniform vec2 u_player_pos = vec2(0.5, 0.5);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "uniform vec3 u_player_move = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "float noise(vec2 st) {\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    return fract(sin(dot(st.xy, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453123);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "}\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "float smooth_noise(vec2 uv) {\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    vec2 i = floor(uv);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    vec2 f = fract(uv);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float a = noise(i);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float b = noise(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float c = noise(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float d = noise(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    return mix(mix(a, b, f.x), mix(c, d, f.x), f.y);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "}\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "void fragment() {\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    // Sanddünen-Struktur (sanfte, große Wellen)\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    vec2 uv = UV * 12.0;\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float t = TIME * 0.3;\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    // Sanftes Wüstenwind-Verzerrungs-Hitzeflimmern\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    vec2 wind = vec2(sin(t + uv.y * 0.3), cos(t * 0.4 + uv.x * 0.3)) * 0.04;\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    // Dezenter Fußabdruck um den Spieler\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    vec2 p = UV - u_player_pos;\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    p.y = -p.y;\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float dist = length(p);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float foot = exp(-dist * dist * 50.0) * clamp(u_player_move.z * 0.0005, 0.0, 0.02);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    vec2 warped_uv = uv + wind + (p * foot);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    // Mehrere Schichten für geschmeidige Sanddünen\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float n1 = smooth_noise(warped_uv);\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float n2 = smooth_noise(warped_uv * 2.2 + vec2(5.1, 2.3)) * 0.4;\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    float dunes = n1 + n2;\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "\n"
./scenes/game/Game.gd:	shader_code += "    // Warme, goldgelbe Wüsten-Farbpalette\n"

./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:# ── Animationen (im Inspector zuweisen) ────────────────────────────────────────

./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:var _fuse_timer := 0.0
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:var _pulse_timer := 0.0
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:var _idle_sprite: AnimatedSprite2D = null

./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:func _ready() -> void:

./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:	# Kollision nur mit Gegnern (Layer 1)

./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:	collision_mask = 1

./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:	# Idle-Sprite konfigurieren

./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:func _process(delta: float) -> void:
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:	if _fused:
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:		return
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:	_fuse_timer -= delta
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:	# Puls-Effekt für den Idle-Sprite
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:	_pulse_timer += delta
./scenes/bombs/Bomb.gd:	if _idle_sprite:

./scenes/player/Player.gd:func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	var dir := Vector2(
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		Input.get_axis("ui_left", "ui_right"),
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		Input.get_axis("ui_up", "ui_down")
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	)
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	velocity = dir.normalized() * float(GameState.stats.speed) if dir != Vector2.ZERO else Vector2.ZERO
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	move_and_slide()
./scenes/player/Player.gd:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	var vp := get_viewport_rect().size
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	global_position = global_position.clamp(Vector2(18, 18), vp - Vector2(18, 18))
./scenes/player/Player.gd:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	# ── HP-Regeneration (Lebensregeneration aus Stats) ───────────────────────────
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	var max_hp := int(GameState.stats.max_health)
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	var regen := float(GameState.stats.hp_regen)
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	if regen > 0.0 and health > 0 and health < max_hp:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		_regen_accumulator += regen * delta
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		if _regen_accumulator >= 1.0:

./scenes/player/Player.gd:func _perform_melee_damage() -> void:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	var enemies := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies")
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	var attack_angle := _attack_direction.angle()
./scenes/player/Player.gd:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:	for enemy in enemies:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		if not is_instance_valid(enemy):
./scenes/player/Player.gd:			continue
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		var e: Node2D = enemy as Node2D
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		if e == null:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:			continue

./scenes/player/Player.gd:		var dist := rel.length()
./scenes/player/Player.gd:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		if dist > melee_range:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:			continue
./scenes/player/Player.gd:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		# Bogen checken
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		var enemy_angle := rel.angle()

./scenes/player/Player.gd:		if angle_diff > PI:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:			angle_diff = TAU - angle_diff
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		if angle_diff > melee_arc / 2.0:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:			continue
./scenes/player/Player.gd:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		# ── Schaden (Krit, Eis/Freeze, Vampirismus aus Stats) ───────────────────

./scenes/player/Player.gd:		# Krit-Treffer?
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		if randf() < GameState.stats.crit_chance:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:			dmg = int(dmg * GameState.stats.crit_damage)
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		# Eis/Freeze-Werte aus Stats
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		var ice := int(GameState.stats.ice_damage)
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		var freeze := float(GameState.stats.freeze_duration)
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		# Tatsächlich zugefügte Menge (nach Gegner-Rüstung) wird zurückgegeben
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		var dealt: int = enemy.take_damage(dmg, global_position, ice, freeze)
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		# Vampirismus: Lebe heilen pro zugefügtem Schaden
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		var lifesteal := float(GameState.stats.lifesteal)
./scenes/player/Player.gd:		if lifesteal > 0.0 and dealt > 0 and health > 0:
./scenes/player/Player.gd:			health = min(health + int(dealt * lifesteal), int(GameState.stats.max_health))
./scenes/player/Player.gd:			GameState.emit_signal("health_changed", health, int(GameState.stats.max_health))

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	if not _player or not is_instance_valid(_player):
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:		return
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	# ── Cooldown herunterzählen ────────────────────────────────────────────────
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	if _attack_cooldown > 0.0:
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:		_attack_cooldown -= delta

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	if not player_moving:

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:		if _wander_timer <= 0.0:

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:			var dist := randf_range(wander_radius * 0.3, wander_radius)
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:			_wander_target = _player.global_position + Vector2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * dist
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:			_wander_timer = wander_pause + randf_range(0.0, 1.5)

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	else:

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	else:

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	# ── Bewegung (immer, auch während Angriff) ──────────────────────────────────

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	else:

./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	# ── Automatischer Nahkampf-Angriff ─────────────────────────────────────────
./scenes/companion/Companion.gd:	if not is_attacking and _attack_cooldown <= 0.0:

./tests/run_tests.gd:## Dependency-free headless test runner.
./tests/run_tests.gd:##
./tests/run_tests.gd:## Usage (after the project has been imported once):
./tests/run_tests.gd:##   godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/run_tests.gd
./tests/run_tests.gd:##
./tests/run_tests.gd:## Loads every tests/unit/test_*.gd, runs each method whose name starts with "test_"
./tests/run_tests.gd:## on a fresh instance, prints one line per test and exits 0 when everything passed,
./tests/run_tests.gd:## 1 otherwise.
./tests/run_tests.gd:
./tests/run_tests.gd:const TEST_DIR := "res://tests/unit"
./tests/run_tests.gd:
./tests/run_tests.gd:
./tests/run_tests.gd:func _initialize() -> void:
./tests/run_tests.gd:	var files: Array[String] = []
./tests/run_tests.gd:	for file in DirAccess.get_files_at(TEST_DIR):
./tests/run_tests.gd:		if file.begins_with("test_") and file.ends_with(".gd"):
./tests/run_tests.gd:			files.append(file)
./tests/run_tests.gd:	files.sort()
./tests/run_tests.gd:
./tests/run_tests.gd:	var passed := 0
./tests/run_tests.gd:	var failed := 0
./tests/run_tests.gd:	var assertions := 0
./tests/run_tests.gd:	for file in files:
./tests/run_tests.gd:		var script: GDScript = load("%s/%s" % [TEST_DIR, file])
./tests/run_tests.gd:		if script == null:
./tests/run_tests.gd:			print("FAIL %s: could not load script" % file)
./tests/run_tests.gd:			failed += 1
./tests/run_tests.gd:			continue
./tests/run_tests.gd:		var names: Array[String] = []
./tests/run_tests.gd:		for method in script.get_script_method_list():
./tests/run_tests.gd:			var method_name: String = method.name
./tests/run_tests.gd:			if method_name.begins_with("test_") and not names.has(method_name):
./tests/run_tests.gd:				names.append(method_name)
./tests/run_tests.gd:		for method_name in names:
./tests/run_tests.gd:			var case = script.new()
./tests/run_tests.gd:			case.before_each()
./tests/run_tests.gd:			case.call(method_name)
./tests/run_tests.gd:			assertions += case.assertions
./tests/run_tests.gd:			if case.failures.is_empty():
./tests/run_tests.gd:				passed += 1
./tests/run_tests.gd:				print("PASS %s::%s" % [file, method_name])
./tests/run_tests.gd:			else:
./tests/run_tests.gd:				failed += 1
./tests/run_tests.gd:				print("FAIL %s::%s" % [file, method_name])
./tests/run_tests.gd:				for failure in case.failures:
./tests/run_tests.gd:					print("     %s" % failure)
./tests/run_tests.gd:
./tests/run_tests.gd:	print("")
./tests/run_tests.gd:	print("%d tests, %d passed, %d failed, %d assertions" % [passed + failed, passed, failed, assertions])
./tests/run_tests.gd:	if passed + failed == 0:
./tests/run_tests.gd:		print("No tests found in %s" % TEST_DIR)
./tests/run_tests.gd:		failed = 1
./tests/run_tests.gd:	quit(0 if failed == 0 else 1)

./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:const OFFER_COUNT := 3
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:## Returns up to `count` distinct upgrades from `pool`, in random order. The pool is
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:## not modified. Pass an `rng` for deterministic rolls (tests); with no rng the global
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:## RNG is used through Array.shuffle(), exactly as the original shop did.
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:static func roll_offers(pool: Array, count: int = OFFER_COUNT, rng: RandomNumberGenerator = null) -> Array:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:	var shuffled := pool.duplicate()
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:	if rng == null:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:		shuffled.shuffle()
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:	else:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:		for i in range(shuffled.size() - 1, 0, -1):
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:			var j := rng.randi_range(0, i)
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:			var tmp = shuffled[i]
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:			shuffled[i] = shuffled[j]
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:			shuffled[j] = tmp
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:	return shuffled.slice(0, min(count, shuffled.size()))
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:static func can_afford(gold: int, upgrade: Dictionary) -> bool:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:	return gold >= int(upgrade.cost)
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:## Gold left after buying `upgrade`, or -1 if it cannot be afforded.

./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:	if not can_afford(gold, upgrade):
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:		return -1
./scripts/logic/ShopRules.gd:	return gold - int(upgrade.cost)
